Game Overview

At its heart, Emoji Merge is a addictive game about combine and evolve emojis in a whimsical journey to build hilarious, high-scoring creations. Strategize each drop to unlock quirky surprises and delight in the endless fun of unexpected emoji fusions. Can you craft the ultimate emoji masterpiece and shatter your high score?
